routes.detail: Mansehra district police closed the Naran–Babusar road on 11 Nov after heavy snowfall; it may stay shut for the winter season. Traffic up to Naran remains open.
routes.name: Babusar Top

routes.detail: Normal traffic both ways; the year-round route into Gilgit-Baltistan while Babusar is closed.
routes.name: KKH — Chilas to Gilgit

routes.detail: Open for all traffic; expect sub-zero temperatures and wind at Khunjerab Pass (4,693m).
routes.name: KKH — Gilgit to Khunjerab

routes.detail: Advisory: rockfall-prone stretches near Stak — travel in daylight and check before night driving.
routes.name: Skardu Road (S-1)

routes.detail: Closed for winter from both the Skardu and Astore sides; normally reopens in June.
routes.name: Deosai Plains

routes.detail: Naran town is reachable and receiving snowfall tourists; the road beyond Bassal towards Babusar is closed by police.
routes.name: Naran & Kaghan Valley

routes.detail: Advisory: icy patches after Gahkuch before 10am in winter — drive slow.
routes.name: Gilgit to Ghizer

routes.detail: The Raikot–Tattu jeep track runs in winter only in good weather; confirm with local jeep operators before going.
routes.name: Fairy Meadows (Raikot)
